items.Sentence: The current treatment system at the Facility consists of headworks, primary sedimentationbasins, aeration basins (nitrification and denitrification), secondary circular clarifiers,tertiary filtration via sand filters, a chlorination contact chamber, dechlorinationfacilities, a concrete- lined emergency storage basin, and flow equalization basins.
